name: RAW Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Named in the fed's own founding handbook as its top title, due to be defended every thirty days and first awarded through a sixteen-man tournament announced for 6 December 1998. No result of that tournament survives in the held record.

name: RAW United States Title
epitaph: Named in the fed's own founding handbook as its second-ranked title. No holder or defense survives on the record.

name: RAW TV Title
epitaph: Named in the fed's own founding handbook as its weekly-defended title, with a first defense announced for 6 December 1998 between two entrants neither otherwise recorded on this wing. No result survives.

name: RAW Tag Team Titles
epitaph: Named in the fed's own founding handbook, due to be defended every fifteen days, with a first defense announced for 6 December 1998 between two teams neither otherwise recorded on this wing. No result survives.
